title: •Special Modifications
caption: •Special Modifications (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your starships about to be lost during the weapons segment of battle remain in play instead. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to make your starship immune to attrition for remainder of turn.
lore: Han’s “special modifications” for _Millennium Falcon_ included security mechanisms, deflector shields, hull plating, faster hyperdrive and enhanced weapons.
